resources.string: Your app use isn\'t being read. Android keeps it for about a week, and it\'s picked up once access is back — anything older is gone.
Battery optimization is on — syncs may be delayed
Notifications are off — you won\'t hear when syncing stops
Set these once so syncing runs on time and the app can tell you when it stops.
Usage access on — the app reads which apps you use. Without it, nothing is read until it\'s back.
Usage access off — your app use isn\'t being read. Android keeps about a week of it.
Battery optimization active — sync may be delayed
Notifications on — you\'ll hear when syncing stops, and about the evening review
Notifications off — the app can\'t tell you when syncing stops (signed out, usage access lost, a day without sending) or ask about the evening review
When sessions stop being recorded or sent
Shown while the app watches which app is in front for a nudge. Silent.
Notices which app is in front so nudges arrive on time. Records nothing.
Your app use isn\'t being read; Android keeps about a week of it. Tap to turn usage access back on.
Your session ended. Sign in again to keep syncing — usage is still recorded meanwhile.
Usage is recorded but not sent. Sign in to keep syncing.
%1$d sessions are waiting — offline, or the server can\'t be reached. Tap to see the status.
Sent %1$d new sessions (%2$d already on the server)
Waiting — offline or the server is busy. Sessions are kept and sent later.
Signed out — sign in again. Sessions are kept until then.
Usage access is off — nothing new is being read
%1$d sessions will be sent with the next sync
The server ignored %1$d sessions (check the phone\'s clock)
The server refused %1$d sessions as malformed; they were discarded
The phone\'s clock is %1$d minutes ahead of the server — sessions from the future are ignored
Unexpected response from the server. Try again.
This account can\'t sign in to the tracker right now. Check the web app.
Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
Your account must set up two-factor authentication. Do it in the web app, then sign in here.
Your session ended. Sign in again — nothing recorded meanwhile is lost.
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication.
That code didn\'t work. Each sign-in allows one try: tap Sign In, then enter the current code.
Once an evening: which apps took your phone time today without being mapped to an activity
%1$s of phone time today isn\'t mapped
%1$s and %2$d more. Tap to map them.
Ask each evening about unmapped phone time
At your evening-shutdown time: the apps that took the most of today without an activity, one tap each. Needs notifications.
When a break from your desk has run past its length while you\'re on your phone
%1$s is still open on your desktop.
Nudge when a break from the desk runs long
When your desktop goes quiet and the phone comes out, during a planned block or after desk work: one nudge once the break is this long. Needs notifications and the desktop tracker.
A short buzz and a heads-up when a distraction app is open during a planned block
Nudge when I open a distraction app during a planned block

One nudge per block once your distraction apps have been open for 30 seconds in it (time in several adds up; a minute away starts over). Back to it goes to the home screen, Switch plan opens the planner, 5 more minutes asks once more. An app mapped to the block\'s own activity doesn\'t count. Waits during calls, Do Not Disturb, car mode, quiet hours, a Phone away timer, and for 10 minutes after another nudge. Needs notifications, and the battery exemption to notice apps.
A short buzz and a few seconds\' heads-up while you stay in an app you chose: how long you\'ve been in it
Leave for 3 minutes and the count starts over.
Chime while I stay in chosen apps

A short buzz and \"15 m on Reddit\" at each interval you stay in the chosen apps — they count together. Leaving for 3 minutes starts over. Quiet during calls and Do Not Disturb. Needs notifications, and the battery exemption to notice the app in front.
The apps you used in the last 7 days, your distraction apps first. The chime counts the time in all chosen apps together.
The apps mapped to an activity you flagged as a distraction, kept up to date from the server. Untick one here to leave it out.
A short buzz and a heads-up when the phone keeps being picked up, or apps hopped through, in a few minutes
With sound, when the time you put the phone away for is up
Want to put the phone away for %1$d?
Check in when I keep picking the phone up

One check-in when the phone is unlocked 6 times in 10 minutes, or 6 apps are hopped through in 5 minutes with none used for over a minute. Put it away starts a quiet timer that sounds when it is up. Quiet during calls and Do Not Disturb. Needs notifications, and the battery exemption to notice pickups.
Tick your chat apps: a run of quick replies isn\'t a loop. A pickup that opens only ticked apps isn\'t counted, and neither is a hop to one. The apps you used in the last 7 days.
%1$s of phone time today isn\'t mapped to an activity. Map the biggest ones — a tap puts their time into History right away.
Ignored — its time is deleted and it isn\'t recorded any more
Ignored on this phone — the server hears about it with the next sync
You have no activities yet. Add some in the web app.
Nothing to review — today\'s phone time is mapped, or too little is left to ask about.
All done. Tomorrow\'s time will be mapped by these rules.
Can\'t reach the server. Check the connection.
The server couldn\'t give today\'s list. Try again in a moment.
That app was mapped meanwhile — reloaded.
That activity no longer exists. Choose another.
Couldn\'t save — check the connection and try again.
An ignored app isn\'t recorded on this phone, and the time already stored for it is deleted.
The apps you used in the last 7 days, busiest first. Ignore one and this phone stops recording it.
No app was used for a minute or more in the last 7 days.
Usage access is off, so this week\'s apps can\'t be listed.
Ignored — the server hears about it with the next sync
Recorded again — the server hears about it with the next sync
Couldn\'t save the ignore, so it\'s recorded again. Tap Ignore to retry.
The server refused to stop ignoring it. Tap Stop ignoring to retry.
%1$s\'s recorded time is deleted, and from now on its use isn\'t recorded. Stopping later won\'t bring that time back.
It is mapped to %1$s now; that stops.
From now on %1$s is recorded again. Time while it was ignored stays unrecorded.
%1$s is ignored on this phone. The server hears about it with the next sync.
The server refused the ignore, so the app is still recorded.
%1$s is recorded again. The server hears about it with the next sync.
The server refused, so the app stays ignored.
%1$d sessions of ignored apps weren\'t stored
I\'ll ask about %1$s again in a week.
An archived activity has this name. Restore it in the web app, or choose another name.
You already have an activity called “%1$s”. Use it?
A role, category or activity was deleted meanwhile. Try again.
Follow the category (none: not a distraction)
The activity picker opens filtered to these for apps of this category, and a new activity starts with them. Nothing is mapped by this alone.
Each app\'s time goes to its activity. A change or an unlink applies from now on.
No app is mapped yet. Add one here, or map one in the evening review.
Time already in History stays where it is.
From now on its time isn\'t mapped, and the evening review asks about it again. Time already in History stays where it is.
That mapping was changed on another device — reloaded.
This is %1$s\'s flag, so it also applies to %2$s.
Every app used this week is mapped or ignored.
Usage access is off, so this week\'s apps can\'t be listed.
